instruction: In VS Code, configure the editor to automatically save files when switching focus to another application

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling auto-save on focus change by setting 'files.autoSave' to 'onFocusChange' in VSCode settings.json. The evaluator uses the existing check_json_settings metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: setting 'files.autoSave' to 'onFocusChange' in VSCode settings.json
Getter (vm_file) correctly fetches the VSCode settings.json file from /home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json
Metric (check_json_settings) properly handles expected parameter when type='rule' - it correctly accesses expected['expected'] to get the settings dictionary
Expected value 'onFocusChange' is semantically correct for enabling auto-save on focus change in VSCode
Complete coverage: all requirements in the instruction are verified by the evaluator
State is accessible: VSCode auto-saves settings.json when settings are changed through the UI
